**Neighbourhood Change Report for test_1**  

Between the two visits, **13 buildings** appeared (12 houses and 1 sports field) across 2 sectors. No buildings disappeared or were modified. The remaining 14 sectors showed no changes, with stability counts ranging from 1 to 18. The sports field and 12 houses were newly observed in previously undeveloped areas.

Neighbourhood test_10 (16 sectors) showed changes in 11 sectors. A total of 19 houses appeared, 2 vegetation features disappeared, and 1 house was modified. No sectors showed complete disappearance or new appearances beyond buildings. The most stable sectors had 6 stable features each.

Neighbourhood test_102 showed changes in 4 sectors out of 16 observed. A total of 7 buildings appeared (1x1, 2x2, 9x house, 1x house, 1x building, 3x building) with no buildings disappearing. No modifications were recorded. The remaining 12 sectors remained stable.

Neighbourhood test_11 showed minimal changes across its 16 observed sectors. Three new houses appeared: one in sector (35.9969,132.5036), one in (35.9966,132.5046), and one in (35.9960,132.5049). One house disappeared in sector (35.9960,132.5017). A total of 4 buildings changed (3 appeared, 1 disappeared). The remaining 12 sectors showed no changes.

Neighbourhood test_115 (16 sectors) showed changes in 11 sectors. A total of 13 buildings appeared (5 in one sector, 8 in another), while 1 building disappeared (in a sector with mixed changes). Houses were the most common new structures, with 26 appearing in one sector and 32 in another. Vegetation also appeared in 1 sector (3 trees). No sectors showed modifications.

Neighbourhood test_118 showed significant changes across its 16 observed sectors. A total of 12 houses and 23 buildings appeared, while 4 vegetation patches disappeared. One house was lost in sector (36.4971,155.0050). Among the 16 sectors, 14 exhibited changes (appearances, disappearances, or modifications), while 2 remained stable.

Neighbourhood test_119 saw 24 new houses, 5 new buildings, and 2 new vegetation areas appear across its 16 sectors. A total of 10 structures disappeared, including 3 houses, 1 vegetation area, and 1 sports field. Changed buildings total 9 (5 appeared, 4 disappeared). The remaining 20 sectors showed no changes.

Neighbourhood test_12 showed changes in 16 observed sectors. A total of 14 houses appeared, with the largest single appearance being 19 houses in one sector. Vegetation disappeared in 3 sectors, totaling 5 instances. No buildings were modified or disappeared.
